claims.statement: For every star T=K_{1,m} with m>=4 and every p satisfying x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2 alpha(T)+1, all m original leaves are favorable and S(T,p)=m*(binom(m-1,p)-binom(m-1,p-1))<0.
claims.scope: Exact star-subfamily result for the registered lower-region ordinary favorable-leaf aggregate; no conclusion for trees outside this family.
claims.reason: retained: direct polynomial and binomial checks verify x(T), both eligibility consequences, every strict favorable-leaf selector value, each original-leaf summand, all m tags, and the zero-extended endpoints. The claim has nonempty scope (m=12,p=8 gives S=-1980). This proves only the star subfamily and supplies no general-tree compensation argument.

limitations: The result is restricted to stars and does not prove or refute the aggregate for arbitrary finite ordinary trees.
No proof of the optional bipartite tagged-incidence identity or its global deficit budget is supplied.
No imported theorem or computation was needed for the retained symbolic subfamily proof.
